lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我昨天在路上遇到一位導演，他說我身高夠高，想請我去拍廣告。可是我從來沒拍過，有點害怕，就說不要了。
lines.simplified: 我昨天在路上遇到一位导演，他说我身高够高，想请我去拍广告。可是我从来没拍过，有点害怕，就说不要了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài lùshàng yùdào yí wèi dǎoyǎn, tā shuō wǒ shēngāo gòu gāo, xiǎng qǐng wǒ qù pāi guǎnggào. Kěshì wǒ cónglái méi pāi guo, yǒudiǎn hàipà, jiù shuō bú yào le.
lines.english: Yesterday I met a director on the street. He said I was tall enough and wanted me to do an ad. But I've never done one and I was a bit scared, so I said no.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼好的機會，不去多可惜啊！沒拍過可以學啊，導演會教你的。
lines.simplified: 这么好的机会，不去多可惜啊！没拍过可以学啊，导演会教你的。
lines.pinyin: Zhème hǎo de jīhuì, bú qù duó kěxí a! Méi pāi guo kěyǐ xué a, dǎoyǎn huì jiāo nǐ de.
lines.english: Such a good chance! What a pity not to go! If you have never done it, you can learn. The director will teach you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳說得也對，讓我再想一想。
lines.simplified: 你说得也对，让我再想一想。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de yě duì, ràng wǒ zài xiǎng yì xiǎng.
lines.english: You have a point. Let me think about it again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de shuō bú yào shì duì de.
choices.english: He was right to say no.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: He should ask his family.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The director should ask someone else.

questions.why: 不去多可惜啊 (what a pity not to go) and 導演會教你的: she wants him to accept. She does not think he was right to refuse, she never mentions his family, and she does not want the director to find someone else.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你女兒要去國外學跳舞？她才十八歲，你不擔心嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你女儿要去国外学跳舞？她才十八岁，你不担心吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ nǚ'ér yào qù guówài xué tiàowǔ? Tā cái shíbā suì, nǐ bù dānxīn ma?
lines.english: I hear your daughter is going abroad to study dance? She is only eighteen. Aren't you worried?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當然擔心啊。可是她從小就愛跳舞，每天練習好幾個小時。能去學自己最喜歡的東西，多好啊！
lines.simplified: 当然担心啊。可是她从小就爱跳舞，每天练习好几个小时。能去学自己最喜欢的东西，多好啊！
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán dānxīn a. Kěshì tā cóngxiǎo jiù ài tiàowǔ, měi tiān liànxí hǎojǐ ge xiǎoshí. Néng qù xué zìjǐ zuì xǐhuān de dōngxi, duó hǎo a!
lines.english: Of course I worry. But she has loved dancing since she was little and practises for hours every day. To study what she loves most — how wonderful!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那她什麼時候出發？
lines.simplified: 那她什么时候出发？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā shénme shíhòu chūfā?
lines.english: So when does she leave?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下個月就走了，先去學兩年。
lines.simplified: 下个月就走了，先去学两年。
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè jiù zǒu le, xiān qù xué liǎng nián.
lines.english: Next month. She will study there for two years first.

choices.pinyin: Nǚ'ér qù guówài niánjì tài xiǎo.
choices.english: His daughter is too young to go abroad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù dānxīn nǚ'ér qù guówài.
choices.english: He is not worried about her going abroad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ'ér qù xué liǎng nián tài jiǔ le.
choices.english: Two years of study is too long.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: It is good that she is going to study dance.

questions.why: 能去學自己最喜歡的東西，多好啊: he thinks it is a good thing. Her age (才十八歲) is the woman's worry, not his point; he says he is worried (當然擔心啊), and he never says two years is too long.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這部電影的導演才二十五歲，劇本也是他自己寫的。
lines.simplified: 这部电影的导演才二十五岁，剧本也是他自己写的。
lines.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de dǎoyǎn cái èrshíwǔ suì, jùběn yě shì tā zìjǐ xiě de.
lines.english: The director of this film is only twenty-five, and he wrote the script himself too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼年輕就能拍出這麼好的電影，多麼不簡單啊！不過裡面的演員，我覺得演得不太好。
lines.simplified: 这么年轻就能拍出这么好的电影，多么不简单啊！不过里面的演员，我觉得演得不太好。
lines.pinyin: Zhème niánqīng jiù néng pāi chū zhème hǎo de diànyǐng, duóme bù jiǎndān a! Búguò lǐmiàn de yǎnyuán, wǒ juéde yǎn de bú tài hǎo.
lines.english: To make such a good film so young — how impressive! But I don't think the actors in it were very good.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我也這麼覺得。聽說他明年還要拍一部新電影，希望能找到更好的演員。
lines.simplified: 我也这么觉得。听说他明年还要拍一部新电影，希望能找到更好的演员。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème juéde. Tīngshuō tā míngnián hái yào pāi yí bù xīn diànyǐng, xīwàng néng zhǎodào gèng hǎo de yǎnyuán.
lines.english: I think so too. I hear he is making a new film next year. I hope he can find better actors.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得這位導演怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得这位导演怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde zhè wèi dǎoyǎn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of this director?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngnián de diànyǐng huì gèng hǎokàn.
choices.english: His film next year will be better.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǎo de yǎnyuán yǎn de hěn hǎo.
choices.english: The actors he chose act well.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn niánqīng jiù hěn huì pāi diànyǐng.
choices.english: He is very good at making films for someone so young.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiě jùběn bǐ pāi diànyǐng hǎo.
choices.english: He writes scripts better than he makes films.

questions.why: 這麼年輕就能拍出這麼好的電影，多麼不簡單啊: she admires how well he makes films at his age. She thinks the actors are weak (演得不太好), she does not compare his scripts with his filming, and next year's film is only the man's news.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說那位明星今天下午在百貨公司幫戲迷簽名，可是要排隊排很久。他週末還會再來一次，你要不要週末再去？
lines.simplified: 听说那位明星今天下午在百货公司帮戏迷签名，可是要排队排很久。他周末还会再来一次，你要不要周末再去？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi míngxīng jīntiān xiàwǔ zài bǎihuò gōngsī bāng xìmí qiānmíng, kěshì yào páiduì pái hěn jiǔ. Tā zhōumò hái huì zài lái yí cì, nǐ yào bú yào zhōumò zài qù?
lines.english: I heard that star is signing autographs for fans at the department store this afternoon, but the line will be long. He's coming again at the weekend. Why not go then?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就算要排三個小時，我也要今天去。他演的每部戲，我都看了好幾遍。
lines.simplified: 就算要排三个小时，我也要今天去。他演的每部戏，我都看了好几遍。
lines.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yào pái sān ge xiǎoshí, wǒ yě yào jīntiān qù. Tā yǎn de měi bù xì, wǒ dōu kàn le hǎojǐ biàn.
lines.english: Even if I have to wait three hours, I'm going today. I've watched every show he's been in several times.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，可是我下午有課，不能陪你去了。
lines.simplified: 好吧，可是我下午有课，不能陪你去了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, kěshì wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu kè, bù néng péi nǐ qù le.
lines.english: All right, but I have class this afternoon, so I can't go with you.

prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？

prompt.english: What is the man going to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhōumò zài qù qǐng tā qiānmíng.
choices.english: Go at the weekend to get his autograph.

choices.speaker: N

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Go with the woman today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nǚ de tì tā qù páiduì.
choices.english: Ask the woman to wait in line for him.

questions.why: 就算要排三個小時，我也要今天去: even a three-hour wait does not change his plan, so he goes today, not at the weekend. She has class (不能陪你去了), so she can neither go with him nor wait in line for him: he goes alone.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下個月有一個模特兒比賽，我很想參加，可是比賽那天剛好要期末考。
lines.simplified: 下个月有一个模特儿比赛，我很想参加，可是比赛那天刚好要期末考。
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yǒu yí ge mótèr bǐsài, wǒ hěn xiǎng cānjiā, kěshì bǐsài nà tiān gānghǎo yào qímòkǎo.
lines.english: There's a modelling contest next month and I really want to enter, but it's on the same day as my final exam.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳要不要問問老師，看能不能改天再考？
lines.simplified: 那你要不要问问老师，看能不能改天再考？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ yào bú yào wènwen lǎoshī, kàn néng bù néng gǎitiān zài kǎo?
lines.english: Then why not ask your teacher if you can take the exam another day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我問過了，老師說不可以，這次只好不參加了。比賽每年都有，就算要再等一年，我也一定要參加！
lines.simplified: 我问过了，老师说不可以，这次只好不参加了。比赛每年都有，就算要再等一年，我也一定要参加！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ wèn guo le, lǎoshī shuō bù kěyǐ, zhè cì zhǐhǎo bù cānjiā le. Bǐsài měi nián dōu yǒu, jiùsuàn yào zài děng yì nián, wǒ yě yídìng yào cānjiā!
lines.english: I did ask. The teacher said no, so this time I'll have to sit it out. The contest is held every year, and even if I have to wait another year, I'm definitely entering!

prompt.traditional: 女的打算怎麼做？

choices.english: Ask the teacher to let her take the exam another day.

questions.why: 這次只好不參加了 rules out next month, and 比賽每年都有 + 就算要再等一年，我也一定要參加 means she will enter next year. Asking the teacher was the man's idea and she has already done it, and she never mentions another contest.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那部新戲下星期就要開始演了，聽說票快賣完了。妳不是很想看嗎？怎麼還不買？
lines.simplified: 那部新戏下星期就要开始演了，听说票快卖完了。你不是很想看吗？怎么还不买？
lines.pinyin: Nà bù xīn xì xià xīngqí jiù yào kāishǐ yǎn le, tīngshuō piào kuài mài wán le. Nǐ bú shì hěn xiǎng kàn ma? Zěnme hái bù mǎi?
lines.english: That new play opens next week, and I hear the tickets are almost sold out. Don't you really want to see it? Why haven't you bought one?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我上網看過了，就算現在買，也只買得到很後面的位子。聽說下個月還會再演，我打算一開始賣票就去買。
lines.simplified: 我上网看过了，就算现在买，也只买得到很后面的位子。听说下个月还会再演，我打算一开始卖票就去买。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàngwǎng kàn guo le, jiùsuàn xiànzài mǎi, yě zhǐ mǎi de dào hěn hòumiàn de wèizi. Tīngshuō xià ge yuè hái huì zài yǎn, wǒ dǎsuàn yì kāishǐ mài piào jiù qù mǎi.
lines.english: I checked online. Even if I buy now, I can only get seats right at the back. I heard they'll put it on again next month, so I plan to buy as soon as those tickets go on sale.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣也好，坐前面才看得清楚。
lines.simplified: 这样也好，坐前面才看得清楚。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng yě hǎo, zuò qiánmiàn cái kàn de qīngchǔ.
lines.english: That's a good idea. You can only see well from the front.

lines.traditional: 這家老電影院下個月就不開了，你知道嗎？
lines.simplified: 这家老电影院下个月就不开了，你知道吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo diànyǐngyuàn xià ge yuè jiù bù kāi le, nǐ zhīdào ma?
lines.english: This old cinema is closing next month. Did you know?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 知道，我很難過。我小時候，爸爸常帶我來這裡，很多好電影我都是在這裡看的。這裡可以說是讓我愛上電影的地方。
lines.simplified: 知道，我很难过。我小时候，爸爸常带我来这里，很多好电影我都是在这里看的。这里可以说是让我爱上电影的地方。
lines.pinyin: Zhīdào, wǒ hěn nánguò. Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu, bàba cháng dài wǒ lái zhèlǐ, hěn duō hǎo diànyǐng wǒ dōu shì zài zhèlǐ kàn de. Zhèlǐ kěyǐ shuō shì ràng wǒ àishàng diànyǐng de dìfāng.
lines.english: Yes, and I'm sad. When I was little, my dad often brought me here, and I saw lots of good films here. You could say this is the place where I fell in love with films.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們這個週末再來看一次吧。
lines.simplified: 那我们这个周末再来看一次吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen zhège zhōumò zài lái kàn yí cì ba.
lines.english: Then let's come and watch one more time this weekend.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳看過那部新電影了嗎？那個演員演一個八十歲的老人，好像真的一樣。
lines.simplified: 你看过那部新电影了吗？那个演员演一个八十岁的老人，好像真的一样。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn guo nà bù xīn diànyǐng le ma? Nàge yǎnyuán yǎn yí ge bāshí suì de lǎorén, hǎoxiàng zhēn de yíyàng.
lines.english: Have you seen that new film? That actor plays an eighty-year-old man, and it looks completely real.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 看過了。他去年演醫生，今年演老人，不管演什麼角色，都演得很好，可以說是現在最有實力的演員，可惜知道他的人不多。
lines.simplified: 看过了。他去年演医生，今年演老人，不管演什么角色，都演得很好，可以说是现在最有实力的演员，可惜知道他的人不多。
lines.pinyin: Kàn guo le. Tā qùnián yǎn yīshēng, jīnnián yǎn lǎorén, bùguǎn yǎn shénme jiǎosè, dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, kěyǐ shuō shì xiànzài zuì yǒu shílì de yǎnyuán, kěxí zhīdào tā de rén bù duō.
lines.english: Yes. Last year he played a doctor and this year an old man. He plays every role well. You could say he is the most able actor today. It's a pity not many people know him.

passage.traditional: 我從小就是個戲迷，可是大學念的是電腦。畢業以後，我白天上班，晚上寫劇本。朋友問我累不累，我說：「{1}每天只有五個小時能睡覺，我也要寫。」剛開始寫的故事，連自己都不喜歡，一直寫{2}好的劇本。後來，一位導演看了我的新劇本，說：「故事很特別，{3}，每個角色都很有意思，觀眾一定會喜歡。」他決定拍這個故事。我{4}他的肯定而更努力了。{5}那位導演，我可能還在公司上班呢！今年{6}我最快樂的一年。
passage.simplified: 我从小就是个戏迷，可是大学念的是电脑。毕业以后，我白天上班，晚上写剧本。朋友问我累不累，我说：「{1}每天只有五个小时能睡觉，我也要写。」刚开始写的故事，连自己都不喜欢，一直写{2}好的剧本。后来，一位导演看了我的新剧本，说：「故事很特别，{3}，每个角色都很有意思，观众一定会喜欢。」他决定拍这个故事。我{4}他的肯定而更努力了。{5}那位导演，我可能还在公司上班呢！今年{6}我最快乐的一年。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù shì ge xìmí, kěshì dàxué niàn de shì diànnǎo. Bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ báitiān shàngbān, wǎnshàng xiě jùběn. Péngyǒu wèn wǒ lèi bú lèi, wǒ shuō: “Jiùsuàn měi tiān zhǐyǒu wǔ ge xiǎoshí néng shuìjiào, wǒ yě yào xiě.” Gāng kāishǐ xiě de gùshì, lián zìjǐ dōu bù xǐhuān, yìzhí xiě bù chū hǎo de jùběn. Hòulái, yí wèi dǎoyǎn kàn le wǒ de xīn jùběn, shuō: “Gùshì hěn tèbié, zàishuō, měi ge jiǎosè dōu hěn yǒuyìsi, guānzhòng yídìng huì xǐhuān.” Tā juédìng pāi zhège gùshì. Wǒ yīnwèi tā de kěndìng ér gèng nǔlì le. Yàobúshì nà wèi dǎoyǎn, wǒ kěnéng hái zài gōngsī shàngbān ne! Jīnnián kě shuō shì wǒ zuì kuàilè de yì nián.
passage.english: I have loved drama since I was a child, but I studied computers at university. After graduating I worked in the day and wrote scripts at night. Friends asked if I was tired. I said, "Even if I can only sleep five hours a night, I will keep writing." Even I didn't like the stories I wrote at first; I just couldn't write a good script. Later a director read my new script and said, "The story is special; besides, every character is interesting. Audiences will surely like it." He decided to film it. Because of his approval, I work even harder. If it weren't for that director, I might still be working at a company! You could say this year is the happiest year of my life.

choices.english: only if
even if
no matter
apart from

questions.why: 也 in 我也要寫 goes with 就算 (even if): even with only five hours of sleep, the writer will still write. 不管 needs a question form (不管睡幾個小時), 只有 goes with 才, and 除了 would need 以外 and makes no sense here.

choices.english: not … down (no room)
can't afford to
can't produce
can't reach

questions.why: 寫不出好的劇本: the writer could not produce a good script. V出 means making something new; 寫不下, 寫不起 and 寫不到 don't mean that.

choices.english: so
no wonder
but
besides

questions.why: 再說 (besides) adds a second good point (every character is interesting) to the first (the story is special), and both lead to 觀眾一定會喜歡. 所以 and 難怪 would make the characters a result of the story, and 可是 needs a contrast.

choices.english: because
as long as
although
not only

questions.why: 因為……而……: 因為他的肯定而更努力了 means the writer works harder because of his approval. 而 needs a cause after 因為.

choices.english: if it weren't for
if
because
although

questions.why: 要不是那位導演 (if it weren't for that director) fits 我可能還在公司上班呢: without him, the writer might still be at the company. 要是 (if) and 因為 (because) would make the director the reason the writer stays at the company, and 雖然 (although) needs a contrast that never comes.

choices.english: originally was
won't be
you could say (it) is
is still not

questions.why: 可說是 means the same as 可以說是 (you could say): with the script being filmed, this year is the writer's happiest. 本來是 points to the past, not to 今年, and 不會是 and 還不是 go against the happy ending.

passage.traditional: 我家樓下住著一位七十歲的老太太。她年輕的時候很想演戲，可是父母不肯讓她去學表演。退休以後，她參加了社區的表演社團，{1}演越好，{2}社團裡最受歡迎的演員了。去年，社團還{3}她演的一部戲而變得有名，很多觀眾都是為了看她才來的。最近，她自己寫{4}了一個新劇本，要演一個大學生。有人說她年紀太大了，她笑著說：「{5}觀眾不喜歡，我也要試試看。{6}，跟年輕的朋友一起練習，讓我覺得自己也變年輕了。」
passage.simplified: 我家楼下住着一位七十岁的老太太。她年轻的时候很想演戏，可是父母不肯让她去学表演。退休以后，她参加了社区的表演社团，{1}演越好，{2}社团里最受欢迎的演员了。去年，社团还{3}她演的一部戏而变得有名，很多观众都是为了看她才来的。最近，她自己写{4}了一个新剧本，要演一个大学生。有人说她年纪太大了，她笑着说：「{5}观众不喜欢，我也要试试看。{6}，跟年轻的朋友一起练习，让我觉得自己也变年轻了。」
passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lóuxià zhù zhe yí wèi qīshí suì de lǎotàitai. Tā niánqīng de shíhòu hěn xiǎng yǎnxì, kěshì fùmǔ bù kěn ràng tā qù xué biǎoyǎn. Tuìxiū yǐhòu, tā cānjiā le shèqū de biǎoyǎn shètuán, yuè yǎn yuè hǎo, kěyǐ shuō shì shètuán lǐ zuì shòu huānyíng de yǎnyuán le. Qùnián, shètuán hái yīnwèi tā yǎn de yí bù xì ér biàn de yǒumíng, hěn duō guānzhòng dōu shì wèile kàn tā cái lái de. Zuìjìn, tā zìjǐ xiě chū le yí ge xīn jùběn, yào yǎn yí ge dàxuéshēng. Yǒu rén shuō tā niánjì tài dà le, tā xiào zhe shuō: “Jiùsuàn guānzhòng bù xǐhuān, wǒ yě yào shìshi kàn. Zàishuō, gēn niánqīng de péngyǒu yìqǐ liànxí, ràng wǒ juéde zìjǐ yě biàn niánqīng le.”
passage.english: A seventy-year-old woman lives downstairs from me. When she was young she wanted to act, but her parents would not let her study acting. After retiring she joined the community drama club. The more she acts, the better she gets, and you could say she is now the most popular actor in the club. Last year the club even became famous because of a play she acted in, and many people in the audience came just to see her. Recently she wrote a new script herself, in which she will play a university student. Some people say she is too old. She laughs and says, "Even if the audience doesn't like it, I still want to try. Besides, practising with young friends makes me feel young again."

choices.english: both / and
also
the more
then

questions.why: 越演越好 (the more she acts, the better she gets) needs 越 in both places, and the second 越 is in the text. 又……又…… joins two descriptions, and 也 and 就 cannot start this pattern.

choices.english: always was
almost was
is no longer
you could say (she) is

questions.why: 越演越好 and 很多觀眾都是為了看她才來的 show she has become the club's most popular actor, so 可以說是 fits. She only began acting after retiring and got better over time, so 本來就是 is wrong, and the audiences who come for her rule out 差一點就是 and 已經不是.

choices.english: although
because
as long as
apart from

questions.why: 因為她演的一部戲而變得有名: the club became famous because of a play she acted in. 而 links a cause after 因為 to its result.

choices.english: out (make something new)
on
into
away

questions.why: 寫出了一個新劇本: V出 shows something new was made, here a new script. 寫上 and 寫進 need a place to write on or into, and 寫走 is not a phrase.

choices.english: even if
not only
only if
moreover

questions.why: 也 in 我也要試試看 goes with 就算 (even if): even if the audience doesn't like it, she will still try. 只有 needs 才, and 不但 and 而且 add a second point of the same kind instead of a condition.

choices.english: no wonder
had to
besides
otherwise

questions.why: She adds another reason to try (practising with young people makes her feel young), so 再說 (besides) fits. 難怪, 只好 and 要不然 do not add a reason.

text.traditional: 很多父母希望孩子將來當醫生或是律師，因為他們覺得這樣的工作錢多，別人也會很肯定他們。所以他們從小就替孩子安排好念什麼學校、學什麼東西。可是孩子長大以後，不一定喜歡父母選的路。我有一個朋友，從小就聽爸爸媽媽的話念法律，當了五年律師。他不討厭這份工作，可是發現自己週末在家做麵包的時候最快樂，最後決定去學做麵包。他父母一開始非常生氣，可是看到大家都很喜歡他做出來的麵包，也慢慢改變了想法。我覺得父母當然可以給孩子意見，但是孩子成年以後，應該讓他們自己決定未來。就算選錯了，也是一次寶貴的經驗。
text.simplified: 很多父母希望孩子将来当医生或是律师，因为他们觉得这样的工作钱多，别人也会很肯定他们。所以他们从小就替孩子安排好念什么学校、学什么东西。可是孩子长大以后，不一定喜欢父母选的路。我有一个朋友，从小就听爸爸妈妈的话念法律，当了五年律师。他不讨厌这份工作，可是发现自己周末在家做面包的时候最快乐，最后决定去学做面包。他父母一开始非常生气，可是看到大家都很喜欢他做出来的面包，也慢慢改变了想法。我觉得父母当然可以给孩子意见，但是孩子成年以后，应该让他们自己决定未来。就算选错了，也是一次宝贵的经验。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō fùmǔ xīwàng háizi jiānglái dāng yīshēng huòshì lǜshī, yīnwèi tāmen juéde zhèyàng de gōngzuò qián duō, biérén yě huì hěn kěndìng tāmen. Suǒyǐ tāmen cóngxiǎo jiù tì háizi ānpái hǎo niàn shénme xuéxiào, xué shénme dōngxi. Kěshì háizi zhǎngdà yǐhòu, bù yídìng xǐhuān fùmǔ xuǎn de lù. Wǒ yǒu yí ge péngyǒu, cóngxiǎo jiù tīng bàba māma de huà niàn fǎlǜ, dāng le wǔ nián lǜshī. Tā bù tǎoyàn zhè fèn gōngzuò, kěshì fāxiàn zìjǐ zhōumò zài jiā zuò miànbāo de shíhòu zuì kuàilè, zuìhòu juédìng qù xué zuò miànbāo. Tā fùmǔ yìkāishǐ fēicháng shēngqì, kěshì kàndào dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuān tā zuò chūlái de miànbāo, yě mànmàn gǎibiàn le xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ juéde fùmǔ dāngrán kěyǐ gěi háizi yìjiàn, dànshì háizi chéngnián yǐhòu, yīnggāi ràng tāmen zìjǐ juédìng wèilái. Jiùsuàn xuǎn cuò le, yě shì yí cì bǎoguì de jīngyàn.
text.english: Many parents hope their children will become doctors or lawyers, because they think such jobs pay well and others will think highly of them. So from early on they arrange which schools their children attend and what they learn. But when the children grow up, they may not like the path their parents chose. A friend of mine studied law because his parents wanted it. He worked as a lawyer for five years. He did not dislike the job, but he found he was happiest when he baked bread at home at the weekend, and in the end he decided to learn to bake bread. His parents were very angry at first, but when they saw how much everyone liked his bread, they slowly changed their minds. I think parents can of course give their children advice, but once children are adults, they should decide their own future. Even if they choose wrong, it is a precious experience.

text.traditional: 很多年輕人在電視上看到明星，就覺得當演員是一件很輕鬆的事，每天只要穿漂亮的衣服、照照相就好了。其實，演員的工作比大家想的辛苦多了。為了演好一個角色，他們得先把劇本看很多遍，了解這個人的性格和生活。有一位演員為了演一位小學老師，還真的到小學去教了一個月的書。拍戲的時候，一場戲常常要拍十幾次，有時候從早上拍到半夜。再說，演員常常得到別的城市工作，很少有時間陪家人。所以，想當演員的人不能只看到明星好看的樣子，還得有吃苦的準備。
text.simplified: 很多年轻人在电视上看到明星，就觉得当演员是一件很轻松的事，每天只要穿漂亮的衣服、照照相就好了。其实，演员的工作比大家想的辛苦多了。为了演好一个角色，他们得先把剧本看很多遍，了解这个人的性格和生活。有一位演员为了演一位小学老师，还真的到小学去教了一个月的书。拍戏的时候，一场戏常常要拍十几次，有时候从早上拍到半夜。再说，演员常常得到别的城市工作，很少有时间陪家人。所以，想当演员的人不能只看到明星好看的样子，还得有吃苦的准备。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng rén zài diànshì shàng kàndào míngxīng, jiù juéde dāng yǎnyuán shì yí jiàn hěn qīngsōng de shì, měi tiān zhǐyào chuān piàoliàng de yīfu, zhàozhao xiàng jiù hǎo le. Qíshí, yǎnyuán de gōngzuò bǐ dàjiā xiǎng de xīnkǔ duō le. Wèile yǎn hǎo yí ge jiǎosè, tāmen děi xiān bǎ jùběn kàn hěn duō biàn, liǎojiě zhège rén de xìnggé hé shēnghuó. Yǒu yí wèi yǎnyuán wèile yǎn yí wèi xiǎoxué lǎoshī, hái zhēn de dào xiǎoxué qù jiāo le yí ge yuè de shū. Pāixì de shíhòu, yì chǎng xì chángcháng yào pāi shí jǐ cì, yǒushíhòu cóng zǎoshàng pāi dào bànyè. Zàishuō, yǎnyuán chángcháng děi dào bié de chéngshì gōngzuò, hěn shǎo yǒu shíjiān péi jiārén. Suǒyǐ, xiǎng dāng yǎnyuán de rén bù néng zhǐ kàndào míngxīng hǎokàn de yàngzi, hái děi yǒu chīkǔ de zhǔnbèi.
text.english: Many young people see stars on TV and think acting is an easy job: you just wear nice clothes and have your photo taken every day. In fact, actors work much harder than people think. To play a role well, they first read the script many times to understand the person's character and life. One actor who was going to play an elementary school teacher really went and taught at a school for a month. When filming, one scene often has to be shot over ten times, sometimes from morning until midnight. Besides, actors often have to work in other cities and have little time for their families. So people who want to be actors cannot see only the stars' good looks; they must also be ready for hard work.

text.traditional: 剛上大學的時候，我對什麼都不感興趣，每天下了課就回宿舍上網。後來，室友帶我去參加吉他社團。一開始，我連一首簡單的歌都不會，可是社員一點都不笑我，還一遍一遍地教我。學期快結束的時候，我們到安養院表演，老人聽得很開心，有一位老太太還拉著我的手，說謝謝我們。那天晚上，我在宿舍想了很久，覺得這是我上大學以後最開心的一天。我從這次活動中發現，跟社員一起練習、一起表演，比一個人在宿舍上網有意思多了。現在，我每個週末都跟社員一起練習吉他，還交到了很多好朋友。
text.simplified: 刚上大学的时候，我对什么都不感兴趣，每天下了课就回宿舍上网。后来，室友带我去参加吉他社团。一开始，我连一首简单的歌都不会，可是社员一点都不笑我，还一遍一遍地教我。学期快结束的时候，我们到安养院表演，老人听得很开心，有一位老太太还拉着我的手，说谢谢我们。那天晚上，我在宿舍想了很久，觉得这是我上大学以后最开心的一天。我从这次活动中发现，跟社员一起练习、一起表演，比一个人在宿舍上网有意思多了。现在，我每个周末都跟社员一起练习吉他，还交到了很多好朋友。

Yìkāishǐ, wǒ lián yì shǒu jiǎndān de gē dōu bú huì, kěshì shèyuán yìdiǎn dōu bú xiào wǒ, hái yí biàn yí biàn de jiāo wǒ. Xuéqí kuài jiéshù de shíhòu, wǒmen dào ānyǎng yuàn biǎoyǎn, lǎorén tīng de hěn kāixīn, yǒu yí wèi lǎotàitai hái lā zhe wǒ de shǒu, shuō xièxie wǒmen. Nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒ zài sùshè xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, juéde zhè shì wǒ shàng dàxué yǐhòu zuì kāixīn de yì tiān. Wǒ cóng zhè cì huódòng zhōng fāxiàn, gēn shèyuán yìqǐ liànxí, yìqǐ biǎoyǎn, bǐ yí ge rén zài sùshè shàngwǎng yǒuyìsi duō le. Xiànzài, wǒ měi ge zhōumò dōu gēn shèyuán yìqǐ liànxí jítā, hái jiāo dào le hěn duō hǎo péngyǒu.
text.english: When I first started university, nothing interested me; after class every day I went back to the dorm and went online. Later my roommate took me to join the guitar club. At first I couldn't play even one simple song, but the members never laughed at me and taught me again and again. Near the end of the semester we performed at a nursing home. The old people enjoyed it very much, and one old lady held my hand and thanked us. That night I sat in the dorm thinking for a long time; it was the happiest day since I had started university. From this event I found that practising and performing with the club members is far more interesting than going online alone in the dorm. Now I practise guitar with them every weekend, and I've made lots of good friends.

text.traditional: 我念大學的時候，為了存學費，在一家義大利餐廳當服務生。除了星期一，每天晚上都得工作到十一點。剛開始，我常常記錯客人點的菜，有一次還不小心把湯倒在客人的衣服上，經理非常生氣。經理要我向一位做了十年的服務生學習，可是她太忙了，沒時間教我。後來，我每天上班以前都先把菜單看兩遍。從那時候起，我就很少弄錯了。這份工作雖然很累，可是讓我學會了怎麼跟不同的人說話，也讓我變得比以前成熟。現在我在一家貿易公司上班，常常得跟國外的客人開會，同事都說我很會跟客人說話。我想，這都是在餐廳打工的時候學會的。
text.simplified: 我念大学的时候，为了存学费，在一家义大利餐厅当服务生。除了星期一，每天晚上都得工作到十一点。刚开始，我常常记错客人点的菜，有一次还不小心把汤倒在客人的衣服上，经理非常生气。经理要我向一位做了十年的服务生学习，可是她太忙了，没时间教我。后来，我每天上班以前都先把菜单看两遍。从那时候起，我就很少弄错了。这份工作虽然很累，可是让我学会了怎么跟不同的人说话，也让我变得比以前成熟。现在我在一家贸易公司上班，常常得跟国外的客人开会，同事都说我很会跟客人说话。我想，这都是在餐厅打工的时候学会的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ niàn dàxué de shíhòu, wèile cún xuéfèi, zài yì jiā Yìdàlì cāntīng dāng fúwùshēng. Chúle xīngqíyī, měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu děi gōngzuò dào shíyī diǎn. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ chángcháng jì cuò kèrén diǎn de cài, yǒu yí cì hái bù xiǎoxīn bǎ tāng dào zài kèrén de yīfu shàng, jīnglǐ fēicháng shēngqì. Jīnglǐ yào wǒ xiàng yí wèi zuò le shí nián de fúwùshēng xuéxí, kěshì tā tài máng le, méi shíjiān jiāo wǒ. Hòulái, wǒ měi tiān shàngbān yǐqián dōu xiān bǎ càidān kàn liǎng biàn. Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ jiù hěn shǎo nòngcuò le. Zhè fèn gōngzuò suīrán hěn lèi, kěshì ràng wǒ xuéhuì le zěnme gēn bùtóng de rén shuōhuà, yě ràng wǒ biàn de bǐ yǐqián chéngshú. Xiànzài wǒ zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī shàngbān, chángcháng děi gēn guówài de kèrén kāihuì, tóngshì dōu shuō wǒ hěn huì gēn kèrén shuōhuà. Wǒ xiǎng, zhè dōu shì zài cāntīng dǎgōng de shíhòu xuéhuì de.
text.english: At university I worked as a waiter in an Italian restaurant to save for my tuition. Except on Mondays, I had to work until eleven every night. At first I often got customers' orders wrong, and once I even spilled soup on a customer's clothes; the manager was very angry. The manager told me to learn from a waiter who had worked there for ten years, but she was too busy to teach me. Later, every day before work I read through the menu twice. From then on I seldom made mistakes. The job was tiring, but it taught me how to talk with all kinds of people and made me more mature than before. Now I work at a trading company and often have meetings with clients from abroad; my colleagues all say I am good at talking with clients. I think I learned all this while working at the restaurant.
